key_insight: Web research agents can follow the same user priority yet apply different judgment criteria, leading to opposing company rankings.
engineering_relevance: Research-agent interfaces and evaluations should expose and test decision criteria, not just topical focus or factual accuracy.
method: Compared OpenAI- and Anthropic-based research agents across 36 runs evaluating Microsoft and Alphabet.
Prompted agents to prioritize growth, prioritize resilience, or use no stated priority.
Analyzed reports, searches, returned sources, and cited sources.
evidence_signal: Of 24 priority-guided reports, 21 focused on the requested priority; growth rankings favored Microsoft in OpenAI reports and Alphabet in Anthropic reports.
watch_item: Findings cover only two agents and one company comparison, so broader generalization requires additional testing.
paper_title: How Web Research Agents Interpret User Priorities
